name: Complete: who, when, where and a linked source
text: In March 2024 the city council in Leeds closed two of its three public libraries to save money, which hit pensioners and schoolchildren hardest. The Yorkshire Post reported the closures on 14 March 2024 (https://www.yorkshirepost.co.uk/news/leeds-library-closures). The council's budget committee should reopen them next year by moving money from the parking budget, and I approve of that.
